message.jaymoskingdoms.blight.stage.1: Your mouth tastes of old coins.
message.jaymoskingdoms.blight.stage.2: Your hands will not keep still, and your legs feel borrowed.
message.jaymoskingdoms.blight.stage.3: The edges of the world go dim, and your stomach turns over.
message.jaymoskingdoms.blight.cured: The sour taste leaves you, and the air is only air.
message.jaymoskingdoms.blight.eased: Something in you settles a little.
